title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Jurisdiction over Administrative Penalty Cases of Customs

articles.content_en:
Fa Shi [2002] No. 4
In order to regulate the scope of cases accepted by maritime courts, and in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the following interpretation is hereby made regarding the litigation jurisdiction over customs administrative penalty cases:
A case in which a party refuses to accept an administrative penalty decision made by Customs and initiates legal proceedings shall be tried by the local People's Court having jurisdiction in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China. If the party initiates legal proceedings with a maritime court, the maritime court shall not accept the case.
